title: Cosmetic Dentistry in Malviya Nagar
seo: Cosmetic Dentistry in Malviya Nagar, South Delhi | Goel Dental
desc: Whitening, veneers, bonding, componeers, gummy smile correction and tooth reshaping at Goel Dental, Malviya Nagar, led by Dr Shikha Goel. Fees and options.
quick: Cosmetic dentistry changes how teeth look: their colour, shape, size, gaps or the gum line. At Goel Dental it is planned by Dr Shikha Goel, and options range from whitening and one-visit bonding to CAD/CAM and E.max veneers. Implant and cosmetic consultations are free on the 2026 fee list.
body:
[gd_img name="zoom" alt="Philips Zoom whitening lamp at Goel Dental" cap="In-clinic whitening"]

What bothers you, and the usual options

ConcernOptions to discuss
Yellow or stained teethTeeth whitening; veneers if whitening is not enough
Gap between front teethBonding, veneers, aligners or braces
Chipped or uneven edgesReshaping, bonding or veneers; see chipped tooth repair
Fluorosis patches or deep stainsBonding, componeers or E.max veneers
Too much gum when smilingGummy smile correction, crown lengthening
Crooked teethBraces or clear aligners

How it is planned

  1. Exam and photos; your teeth and gums must be healthy first.
  2. A digital preview of the planned smile, where the case allows.
  3. Options and fees in writing, from the least to the most tooth trimming.

Same-day work is possible with the clinic's CEREC CAD/CAM system. See technology.

Fees

Cosmetic consultation: free on the 2026 fee list. Bonding about ₹2,000 per tooth; CAD/CAM composite veneer about ₹8,000; E.max veneer ₹12,000–14,000. [gd_confirm]Confirm cosmetic fees[/gd_confirm]

More smile cases are on the clinic's cosmetic site, Delhi Dental Smiles.

Questions

Is cosmetic treatment done on unhealthy teeth?

No. Cavities and gum problems are treated first, then the cosmetic work is planned.

Which option needs the least trimming?

Whitening and bonding need little or none. Veneers need a thin layer of enamel removed; crowns need the most.

title: Teeth Whitening in Malviya Nagar
seo: Teeth Whitening & Zoom Whitening in Malviya Nagar | Goel Dental
desc: In-clinic bleaching, Philips Zoom whitening and take-home trays at Goel Dental, Malviya Nagar. Who it suits, what it can't do, how to keep results, fees.
quick: Teeth whitening lightens stains from tea, coffee, tobacco and food. Goel Dental offers in-clinic bleaching, Philips Zoom whitening (about 30–45 minutes) and custom take-home trays. Teeth must be free of cavities first, and results fade over time, so touch-ups are needed.
body:
[gd_img name="zoom" alt="Philips Zoom whitening lamp with before and after shade comparison" cap="Philips Zoom whitening"]

Options

OptionHowTime
In-clinic bleachingGums are covered; a peroxide gel is applied and activated with a light1 visit
Philips ZoomZoom's own gel and lampAbout 30–45 minutes
Take-home traysCustom trays with whitening gel, worn as the dentist directsResults over 2–3 weeks

In-clinic whitening can use a stronger gel than home kits, under the dentist's control. How much lighter teeth get varies from person to person.

Before you whiten

  • Cavities are filled first; existing sensitivity is checked.
  • Whitening does not change the colour of fillings, crowns or veneers.
  • A cleaning first often removes surface stains.

Keeping the result

  • Rinse with water after tea, coffee or red wine; avoid smoking.
  • Touch-ups every 6–12 months, as advised.
  • Over-bleaching can harm enamel; very white teeth can look unnatural.

Fee

In-clinic bleaching ₹8,000; Zoom ₹15,000–20,000 (older clinic page). [gd_confirm]Confirm whitening fees[/gd_confirm]

Questions

Is teeth whitening permanent?

No. Results fade with food and drink; good hygiene and touch-ups prolong them.

Does whitening cause sensitivity?

Some people feel temporary sensitivity. The dentist checks for it before starting and adjusts the treatment.

title: Dental Veneers in Malviya Nagar
seo: Dental Veneers in Malviya Nagar: Types & Cost | Goel Dental
desc: Composite, CAD/CAM composite and E.max ceramic veneers compared: trimming, visits, strength, look and fees. Same-day CEREC veneers at Goel Dental.
card: Composite, CAD/CAM or E.max; same-day possible
quick: Veneers are thin shells bonded to the front of teeth to change their colour, shape or size, or close gaps. Goel Dental offers composite bonding (about ₹2,000 per tooth), CAD/CAM composite veneers (about ₹8,000) and E.max ceramic veneers (₹12,000–14,000), several in a single visit with its CEREC system.
body:
[gd_img name="veneer-case-2-post" alt="Front teeth after E.max veneers at Goel Dental" cap="E.max veneers on uneven front teeth"]

What veneers can fix

  • Gaps between front teeth
  • Chipped or cracked edges
  • Deep stains or fluorosis when whitening is not enough
  • Slightly uneven or misshapen teeth

Types compared

TypeTrimmingVisitsStrengthFee per tooth
Composite bondingLittle or none1Lower₹2,000
CAD/CAM composite0.3–0.5 mm1Medium₹8,000
ComponeerFrom 0.3 mm1Medium₹6,000–8,000
E.max ceramic0.3–0.5 mm1–2High₹12,000 (lab) / ₹14,000 (same-day)

[gd_confirm]Confirm veneer fees[/gd_confirm]

The process

  1. Consultation and a digital preview of the new smile
  2. Minimal trimming and a 3D scan; no impression trays
  3. Veneers designed and milled in the clinic (or made in a lab)
  4. Hand-finished for a natural surface, then bonded

Good to know

  • Veneers are not reversible once enamel is trimmed.
  • They are not placed during braces treatment.
  • Night grinders may need a night guard.

Questions

How long do veneers last?

It depends on the type and care. Composite veneers last the least; ceramic veneers the longest.

Can veneers match my other teeth?

Yes. The shade is recorded digitally and matched; a lighter shade can also be chosen.

title: E.max Ceramic Veneers
seo: E.max Ceramic Veneers in Malviya Nagar, Delhi | Goel Dental
desc: E.max (lithium disilicate) veneers made same-day with CEREC, or lab-pressed in about 5 working days. Process, who they suit, fees from ₹12,000.
quick: E.max veneers are thin lithium disilicate ceramic shells, bonded to front teeth. Goel Dental makes them in one visit with its CEREC CAD/CAM system, or has them pressed in a lab in about 5 working days for multi-tooth smile makeovers. Fees are ₹12,000–14,000 per tooth.
body:
[gd_img name="veneer-case-2-pre" alt="Uneven front teeth before E.max veneers" cap="Before"][gd_img name="veneer-case-2-post" alt="Front teeth after E.max veneers" cap="After"]

Two ways to make them

Same-day (CEREC)Lab-pressed
MadeDesigned and milled in the clinicPressed and layered in a dental lab
TimeOne appointmentAbout 5 working days
SuitsOne to a few teethMulti-tooth smile makeovers
Fee₹14,000 per tooth₹12,000 per tooth

[gd_confirm]Confirm E.max fees[/gd_confirm]

The process

  1. Digital smile preview and consultation
  2. 3D scan
  3. Veneers made in the clinic or lab, then hand-textured
  4. Bonded with a high-strength cement

A case from the clinic

A patient with fluorosis stains wanted six upper veneers. After a digital simulation, two front veneers were enough. They were milled in the clinic from E.max blocks, hand-finished to match his natural mottling and bonded the same day.

The old page mentions a 5-year warranty on E.max veneers. [gd_confirm]Confirm warranty terms before publishing[/gd_confirm]

Questions

How are E.max veneers different from composite?

E.max is a glass-ceramic: stronger, more stain-resistant and more translucent than composite, but it costs more.

Do E.max veneers need anaesthetic?

Often little or none, as trimming is minimal. The dentist decides per tooth.

title: Dental Bonding
seo: Dental Bonding for Gaps & Chips in Malviya Nagar | Goel Dental
desc: Tooth-coloured resin shaped onto front teeth in one visit to close gaps, fix chips and mask stains. About ₹2,000 per tooth. Goel Dental, Malviya Nagar.
card: One visit, little or no trimming
quick: Dental bonding shapes tooth-coloured resin onto a tooth in one visit, usually without anaesthetic, to close small gaps, fix chipped edges, mask stains or change a tooth's shape. It costs about ₹2,000 per tooth. Bonding can discolour over the years but can be polished or redone.
body:
Good for

  • A gap between front teeth
  • Stains on front teeth
  • Chipped edges
  • Teeth that look too short, broad, thin or long

How it is done

  1. The tooth surface is prepared.
  2. Resin is applied, shaped and hardened with a blue light.
  3. It is smoothed and polished to blend with your teeth.

Bonding or a CAD/CAM composite veneer?

A CAD/CAM composite veneer is milled in the clinic from a factory-made block, so it has more shade options and picks up fewer stains. It costs about ₹8,000 per tooth. See veneers compared.

Fee

Bonding: about ₹2,000 per tooth. CAD/CAM composite veneer: about ₹8,000. [gd_confirm]Confirm fees[/gd_confirm]

Questions

Does bonding damage the tooth?

Little or no enamel is removed, so it is one of the most conservative cosmetic options.

Will bonding stain?

Over the years it can pick up colour, especially with tea and coffee. It can be re-polished or redone.

desc: Componeers: prefabricated nano-hybrid composite veneer shells fitted in 45–60 minutes, from 0.3 mm thin. Who they suit and fees (₹6,000–8,000).

quick: Componeers are factory-made composite veneer shells, from 0.3 mm thin, bonded to front teeth in about 45–60 minutes. They cost ₹6,000–8,000 per tooth, less than ceramic veneers. Patients return once a year for a check and re-polish.

What they are

COMPONEER is a brand of pre-shaped, polymerised nano-hybrid composite enamel shells. They combine the speed of direct bonding with the uniform finish of a factory-made veneer.

Who they suit

  • Single front teeth or a whole front smile
  • People who want a quick change at lower cost than ceramic

At a glance

Time45–60 minutes
ThicknessFrom 0.3 mm
Fee₹6,000–8,000 per tooth [gd_confirm]Clinic to confirm[/gd_confirm]
AftercareYearly check and re-polish

Questions

Componeers or E.max veneers?

Componeers are quicker and cost less; E.max ceramic is stronger and more stain-resistant. See veneers compared.

title: Gummy Smile Correction
seo: Gummy Smile Correction in Malviya Nagar | Goel Dental
desc: Showing too much gum when you smile? The cause is assessed first; options include laser gingivectomy, crown lengthening and veneers. Goel Dental.
card: Cause found first; laser and surgical options
who: Dr Ambica Sharma, periodontist, with Dr Shikha Goel
quick: A gummy smile shows more gum than people like. The treatment depends on the cause: gum covering too much tooth, short teeth, lip movement or jaw position. Options include laser gingivectomy, crown lengthening, veneers and, rarely, jaw surgery.
body:
What is assessed

  • How much gum shows when you smile
  • The size and shape of the teeth
  • How far the upper lip moves when you speak and smile
  • The position of the upper jaw

Options, by cause

CauseUsual option
Extra gum over the teethGingivectomy, often with a laser
Teeth partly covered by gum and boneCrown lengthening
Short or worn teethVeneers after gum reshaping
Upper jaw positionJaw (orthognathic) surgery, referred to an oral surgeon

Gum procedures are done by Dr Ambica Sharma, periodontist. The clinic has a Biolase soft-tissue laser.

Fee

[gd_confirm]Fee for gummy smile correction[/gd_confirm] EMI on leading credit cards.

Questions

Is a gummy smile a health problem?

Usually not; it is a cosmetic concern. Gum swelling from disease is different and is treated first.

title: Tooth Reshaping and Contouring
seo: Tooth Reshaping & Contouring in Malviya Nagar | Goel Dental
desc: Small chips, uneven edges and pointed canines smoothed by removing a tiny amount of enamel, usually in one visit without anaesthetic. When it suits, when it doesn't.
quick: Tooth reshaping (contouring) removes a very small amount of enamel to smooth small chips, even out edges or shorten pointed canines. It usually takes one visit without anaesthetic. It suits minor changes only; bigger flaws need bonding or veneers.
body:
Good for

  • Small chips
  • Bulges or pits in the enamel
  • Slightly uneven tooth shapes
  • Long or pointed canines

How it is done

  1. X-rays check the tooth and the bone around it.
  2. The dentist marks the areas to shape.
  3. Enamel is smoothed with fine instruments and abrasive strips between teeth.
  4. The teeth are polished.

It is often combined with bonding or whitening.

When it is not suitable

Large chips, deep fractures or badly crooked teeth need veneers, crowns or braces. Removing too much enamel weakens teeth, so changes are kept small.

Fee

[gd_confirm]Fee for reshaping[/gd_confirm]

Questions

Does reshaping hurt?

Usually not; enamel has no nerves, so anaesthetic is rarely needed.

title: Implant-Supported Dentures
seo: Implant-Supported Dentures in Malviya Nagar | Goel Dental
desc: Dentures that clip onto or are fixed to implants so they don't slip when you eat or talk. Removable and fixed types, who they suit. Goel Dental, Malviya Nagar.
who: Dr Shikha Goel with the oral surgeon
quick: An implant-supported denture is held in place by dental implants instead of resting only on the gums, so it does not slip when you eat or talk. It can be removable (clipping onto the implants for cleaning) or fixed. It suits people with no teeth in a jaw who cannot have, or don't want, a full fixed implant bridge.
body:
[gd_img name="implant-model" alt="Dental implant model at Goel Dental" cap="Implant planning"]

Types

TypeHow it staysCleaning
Removable (overdenture)Press-stud style attachments on the implantsTaken out to clean
FixedScrewed onto abutments on the implantsCleaned in the mouth; removed only by the dentist

Compared with a normal denture

  • Does not slip while eating or speaking
  • Usually needs replacing less often
  • Needs implant surgery and enough jaw bone

Who is suitable

Good general health, enough bone (or grafting) and healthy gums. Uncontrolled diabetes or blood pressure must be controlled first. A CBCT scan confirms the plan.

For fixed teeth on four or six implants, see All-on-4 and All-on-6.

Fee

[gd_confirm]Fee for implant-supported dentures[/gd_confirm] Implants from ₹17,000 each by brand; EMI available.

Questions

How many implants hold a denture?

Commonly two to four in the lower jaw, more in the upper. The dentist advises after the scan.

title: Implant-Supported Bridge (Several Missing Teeth)
seo: Implant Bridge for Several Missing Teeth, Malviya Nagar | Goel Dental
desc: Replace three or four teeth in a row on two implants, without trimming neighbouring teeth. Who it suits, timeline (3–6 months), fees. Goel Dental.
who: Dr Shikha Goel with the oral surgeon
quick: An implant-supported bridge replaces several missing teeth in a row using fewer implants: two implants can usually carry three or four teeth. Unlike a normal bridge, the neighbouring natural teeth are not trimmed. Treatment takes about 3–6 months in stages, longer if bone grafting is needed.
body:
How it works

Implants are placed at each end of the gap. Once they have bonded with the bone, a bridge of three or more joined teeth is fixed on them.

Who it suits

  • Several missing teeth next to each other
  • Neighbouring teeth too weak, or too healthy, to support a normal bridge

Timeline

  1. Exam and CBCT scan
  2. Implant placement
  3. Healing, usually 3–4 months
  4. Bridge fitted

Add time if a bone graft or sinus lift is needed.

Fee

Implants from ₹17,000 each by brand; crowns on implants ₹8,500–17,000. [gd_confirm]Fee for an implant bridge[/gd_confirm]

Questions

How long does an implant bridge last?

Many years with good cleaning and regular check-ups. Smoking and gum disease shorten its life.

title: Implant or Bridge: Which Is Right for You?
seo: Dental Implant vs Bridge: Pros, Cons & Cost | Goel Dental
desc: Implant or bridge for a missing tooth? How each works, when a bridge makes more sense, and how costs compare over time. Goel Dental, Malviya Nagar.
card: How to choose for one missing tooth
quick: An implant replaces only the missing tooth; a bridge trims the teeth on both sides to hold a false tooth. Implants usually last longer and protect neighbouring teeth. A bridge can make more sense when the neighbouring teeth already need crowns, or when the bone or gums need extra work before an implant.
body:
Side by side

ImplantBridge
Neighbouring teethUntouchedTrimmed to hold the bridge
Time3–6 months, in stagesAbout 1–2 weeks
SurgeryYes, minorNo
LifespanLong-term with careOften 10–15 years; teeth underneath can decay
Cost nowFrom ₹17,000 + crownSimilar to or less than an implant for one tooth

When a bridge may be better

  • The neighbouring teeth already have large fillings or root canals and need crowns anyway
  • The tooth has been missing for long and the bone needs grafting
  • Medical reasons against surgery

Ask yourself

  • Do you want to avoid trimming healthy teeth?
  • Is your current denture or bridge loose?
  • Do you want a fixed, stable result?

The dentist recommends after an exam and scan. Free implant consultation on the 2026 fee list.

Questions

Is an implant always better than a bridge?

No. It depends on the neighbouring teeth, bone, health and budget.
